maturity_assessment.target_level: L7 runtime with task router, evaluator, evidence ledger, and learning promotion records
maturity_assessment.evidence_level: L2 after commit and L3 after local or CI checks

selection_policy: Select the highest-priority item with satisfied dependencies, A0-A4 risk, checkable acceptance gate, explicit rollback path, and no real-world, credential, production, external-service, merge, or direct-main boundary crossing. A5 packets may be drafted only. A6 stops at the human gate.

items.title: Add persistent AOOS runtime backlog contract
items.acceptance_gate: Schema-backed backlog record exists, is linked from AOOS navigation, and aoos_stage45_check_v1 validates required fields.
items.rollback_path: revert the scoped backlog commit and remove the AOOS backlog navigation link
items.next_action: Use the completed backlog contract to select the next safe A0-A4 item.
items.promotion_rule_if_repeated_failure: If backlog records drift twice, promote required-field checks into CI and the final-report checklist.

items.title: Seed append-only evidence ledger records for AOOS task outcomes
items.acceptance_gate: A minimal AOOS evidence ledger seed record maps repository claims to evidence levels without claiming real-world validation.
items.rollback_path: revert the scoped evidence-ledger seed commit
items.next_action: Push the PR branch and use CI plus human review as the next evidence gate.
items.evaluator_required: claim_to_evidence_check_v1 plus AOOS ledger fixture validation
items.promotion_rule_if_repeated_failure: If evidence levels are misstated twice, promote a stricter claim-to-evidence fixture into CI.

items.title: Add risk classifier fixture for A0-A6 authority decisions
items.acceptance_gate: Representative tasks classify into A0-A6 with explicit human gates and forbidden stronger actions.
items.rollback_path: revert the scoped classifier fixture commit
items.next_action: Add only after the backlog contract is accepted enough to avoid another parallel policy surface.
items.promotion_rule_if_repeated_failure: If agents misclassify the same gate twice, promote that case into the classifier fixture and high-risk gate docs.

items.title: Add task-router scaffold that emits observability and decision references
items.acceptance_gate: A non-executing router fixture maps task class to owner role, risk class, evidence requirement, and next gate.
items.rollback_path: revert the scoped router scaffold commit
items.next_action: Keep as fixture-only until human review accepts the AOOS interface direction.
items.promotion_rule_if_repeated_failure: If routing contradictions repeat, promote the route into a script-backed evaluator rather than another prose protocol.

items.title: Add failure-to-memory promotion evaluator fixture
items.acceptance_gate: Recurring failures map to checklist, playbook, script, CI, evaluator, policy, or backlog promotion without relying on chat memory.
items.rollback_path: revert the scoped promotion fixture commit
items.next_action: Add after evidence-ledger seed records exist so failures can point to durable evidence refs.
items.promotion_rule_if_repeated_failure: If the same failure is handled manually twice, add a script or CI check for that invariant.

items.title: Prepare real-world feedback ingestion packet
items.evidence_requirement: L0 proposal until human-provided source records exist
items.acceptance_gate: A proposal packet defines how user, customer, payment, delivery, or platform feedback would enter the evidence ledger without executing outreach.
items.rollback_path: remove the proposal packet before merge if it blurs the real-world boundary
items.next_action: Draft only when requested or after human review; do not contact users, customers, platforms, or accounts.
items.evaluator_required: claim-to-evidence review for L5 source-record boundaries
items.promotion_rule_if_repeated_failure: If real-world claims are overstated twice, promote the missing-source-record rule into CI and final-report checks.
